notes.title: Geadows Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[b]We want to thank you again for your reception! Another day in Free to Play New and Trending![/b]

This morning we launched an update fixing a critical bug with the sensitivity that appeared with yesterday's hotfix. This one, however, focuses in adding a little bit of content and polishing.

[b]Changelist:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Sniper's turret can no longer target traps, only enemies.
[*]The Sniper's turret, when placed in the air, stays in that position instead of appearing on the ground.
[*]The turbine works now! If it receives damage, it starts to shoot lightnings damaging the player, ally units and enemies. After some time, it explodes dealing big area damage.
[*]When finishing a level and deactivating traps, their lights turn off, indicating that they are inactive.
[/list]

notes.title: Geadows Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[b]Two days after release and we're in Free to Play New and Trending! We're so thankful![/b]

This hotfix focuses generally on fixing the general stability issues the game has, [b]mainly focusing on the green zone[/b]. We hope these changes work for you and we'll continue fixing bugs and adding content and polish!

[b]Changelist[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the hostile support alert text to not disappear when you killed the support too fast.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the lasers of the Gargantuan Drone summons to stay in the scene after the combat ended.
[*]Added general stability improvements mainly focused on the blue and green zones.
[*]We changed some aspects about the game's decoration, such as the blue zone walls or the traps along all the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Geadows Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[b]Geadows is out and we're stunned with all your downloads and possitive feedback! Thanks to you all![/b]

To celebrate our first 24 hours, we're rolling out our first hotfix fixing some minor bugs and adding a few QoL changes to support enemies. [b]We're aware that the green zone causes some big frame rate drops[/b] and are currently working on it.

We'll also add Steam achievements in the future, so stay tuned!

[b]Changelist:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused weapon unlock conditions to appear bigger than expected.
[*]Fixed some accessories descriptions.
[*]Buffed both the Damage On Jumps and Plummet upgrades.
[*]Added a marker and an alert text when a support enemy spawns so it is easier to spot.
[*]Fixed a bug that made one green zone level unplayable.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Rocket Launcher's charged attack to malfunction in the Gargantuan Drone combat.
[/list]
